title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #25 (가로 띠 4구역·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Indian woman, an adult, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real pores, real living eyes, 5 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum an anklet. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 46% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with angular fragment planes filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, with zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
